class.name: OcgGraphic3dLightset
class.brief_description: Class defining the set of light sources.
class.description: ! Class defining the set of light sources.

method.name: IsEmpty
method.description: Return TRUE if lights list is empty.

method.name: Value
method.description: Return the light source for specified index within range [Lower(), Upper()].

method.name: Contains
method.description: Return TRUE if light source is defined in this set.

method.name: NbLightsOfType
method.description: Returns total amount of lights of specified type.

method.name: NbEnabled
method.description: Returns total amount of enabled lights EXCLUDING ambient.

method.name: NbEnabledLightsOfType
method.description: Returns total amount of enabled lights of specified type.

method.name: NbCastShadows
method.description: Returns total amount of enabled lights castings shadows.
